_comment_treat_no_relevant_lines_as_cove: Deviation from the satellite shape, carried from statifier_blocks (sb-p6s). The flag is display-only: excoveralls checks minimum_coverage against the run total, and a file with zero relevant lines contributes nothing to that total either way (measured 2026-09-13: 95.4% with the flag on and 95.4% with it off, green both times). The display-only reading is what holds as this package stands, and the earlier claim that the flag kept the gate off the 90% floor no longer holds. It did hold for the moduledoc-only scaffold this package began as: when the run's total relevant lines are themselves 0, excoveralls returns this flag's default value AS the total (100.0% with the flag, 0.0% without), so the flag alone decided pass or fail against the 90% floor. It only changes the per-file column for the two modules that compile no executable lines - Encryptor.Ecto (moduledoc only) and Encryptor.Ecto.TenantContext (typedocs and one @callback) - which read 100.0% with the flag and 0.0% without it. Kept so those rows do not read as uncovered code.
